payload.title: Basic timeseries manipulation
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates basic timeseries manipulation using the Pyleoclim library, focusing on pre-processing techniques such as slicing, standardizing, and gaussianizing a timeseries. It uses sea-surface temperature data from the NINO3 region to illustrate these methods.

steps.description: Load necessary libraries and the NINO3 dataset, then plot the original data.
steps.title: Preamble and Data Loading

steps.description: Slice the timeseries data to focus on a specific time period (1972-1998) and plot the sliced data against the original.
steps.title: Slicing the Timeseries

steps.description: Calculate and display summary statistics of the original timeseries using both Pyleoclim and Pandas methods.
steps.title: Summary Statistics

steps.description: Standardize the timeseries by subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation, then plot the standardized data.
steps.title: Standardizing the Timeseries

steps.description: Transform the timeseries to follow a standard Gaussian distribution and plot the Gaussianized data.
steps.title: Gaussianizing the Timeseries

steps.description: Compare the original, standardized, and Gaussianized timeseries using Seaborn for visual comparison.
steps.title: Comparison of Data Treatments
